scope: Development on all 24 phase-20 plaintext passages; no new target passages are selected or fitted yet.
selection_rule: Highest macro boundary F1 over all 24 old passages with correct letters; ties prefer larger beta then larger penalty. One shared parameter pair for Latin and Italian.
score: 0.95 * lexical_trigram_log_score + 0.05 * boundary_character_log_score + sum_unknown(beta * spelling_log_probability + length_log_prior - penalty)
probabilistic_interpretation: Weighted score, not a normalized probability of a whole text. The spelling and length features overlap.
